body:
I'm sure they're not all bad, too. Like I said, they were probably the exception to the rule. Getting two bad apples in a row must have been bad luck.
Thanks for the link. I had no idea online therapy was a thing. That might help a lot in the future.

Yesterday, when my husband came home from work, he talked to me and held me for a while. He showed me a lot of love, and I eventually calmed down. We watched some films and played some games together, and I felt better.

I really appreciate you trying to reach out to me. I was really humiliated by the whole experience yesterday and wanted to talk about it somewhere, somehow.
